about: The text a note's properties hold, where reference keys are looked for: brainstead_core::projects::property_text (a project's, for Tickets and links and list_projects' references) and propertyText in src/md/noteRefs.ts (a note's, for its References card) give it from the properties as the index parses them. Both tests read these cases. yaml: the front matter; properties: what it parses to; text: what both give, in any order.

cases.name: text values and the items of a list, not a number, a tag or an alias
cases.yaml:
status: active
tickets: [ORBIT-12, ORBIT-14]
stage: 3
tags: [ORBIT-99]
aliases: [ORBIT-98]

cases.name: a comment is not a value
cases.yaml:
status: active # ORBIT-3
# ORBIT-7 on a line of its own

cases.name: a nested property is not read
cases.yaml:
jira:
  epic: ORBIT-4
summary: About ORBIT-5

cases.name: a block list, trimmed, without its blank and other items; label names in any case
cases.yaml:
tickets:
  - ORBIT-6
  - 7
  - " "
  - [ORBIT-8]
note: ""
Tag: ORBIT-9
Alias: [ORBIT-10]
owner: "  Maya  "
